$comment: Risk tiers for merge-gate.yml, evaluated by scripts/risk-tier.mjs. Globs: * matches within one path segment, ** across segments. Rules are checked in order: high, then low, then medium as the default.

high.description: Needs a human approval plus code-owner review (ruleset). AI review is advisory.

low.description: Can be auto-merged once every required check passes.

dependabot.description: Dependabot npm updates that only touch package.json and package-lock.json.

medium.description: Everything else: needs one human approval.
